name: Indaial (Brazil)
description: Gyronny of red and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms: a red shield edged in yellow bearing crossed arrows and a border of bezants.
history: Indaial is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 21 February 1972 (prescribed by Municipal Law No. 670 of 21 February 1972, the arms by Law No. 664 of 2 February 1972, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: shield edged in yellow with crossed arrows and 34 bezants for the year of foundation
